_comment: Sandhill's Suggested skills (Huan, 2026-11-16; docs/design/done/skills-plan.md). Each is fetched from its repository at the pinned commit when the user presses Add; nothing here is shipped with Sandhill. All are Apache-2.0 (checked 2026-11-16).

skills.name: scvi-tools
skills.description: Deep-learning single-cell methods: integration and batch correction (scVI, scANVI), CITE-seq, multiome, ATAC, spatial deconvolution, label transfer.

skills.name: Single-cell RNA QC
skills.description: Quality control of scRNA-seq data (.h5ad, .h5) with scverse best practices: MAD-based filtering and QC plots.

skills.name: Nextflow and nf-core
skills.description: Run nf-core pipelines (rnaseq, sarek, atacseq) on local FASTQs or public GEO/SRA data, including samplesheets.

skills.name: Instrument data to Allotrope
skills.description: Convert lab instrument files (PDF, CSV, Excel, TXT) to Allotrope Simple Model JSON or flat CSV for LIMS and data lakes.

skills.name: Scientific problem selection
skills.description: Choosing and pitching research problems, evaluating project risk and getting unstuck, after Fischbach and Walsh.

skills.name: Clinical trial protocol
skills.description: Draft clinical trial protocols for medical devices or drugs, with research into similar trials.

skills.name: Clinical trial forecast
skills.description: A registered trial's probability of success: checked research, a Monte Carlo model and a cited report. Written for Claude Science.

skills.name: Binder gauntlet
skills.description: Validate de novo protein binders: independent re-prediction, controls, developability and sequence liabilities, and a dossier.
